purpose: PRECOMMIT a zero-leverage CASH RESERVE fixed-fraction sensitivity for ALL original 47 frozen Bybit Spot BTCUSDT MR40 LONG events. It is a risk envelope diagnostic based on the SAME seen historical data, NOT optimization or a Paper sizing change.

source.signal_engine: ClosedMR40 verified first entry Z<=-2, exit Z>=0 Momentum30, Spot only; do not modify source, decision or dates
source.entry_exit: One full selected fraction of available quote at next 4h OPEN after entry close signal, natural exit next 4h OPEN after close signal, everything else USD cash; no stop, no trailing, no leverage, no order

fixed_scenarios.reference_fee: Bybit public VIP0 Spot taker illustrative 0.001 EACH of buy and sell; actual account fee not confirmed
fixed_scenarios.realized_only_max_dd: Track previous closed-trade cash peaks and exit balances from same chronology.
fixed_scenarios.intrapos_OHLC_lower: Prior bar highs plus prior closed cash peaks must precede current 4h Low. Exclude exit-bar post-exit high/low.
fixed_scenarios.intrapos_OHLC_adversarial_upper: Pretend current bar high happened before its low; bound but never declare actual high-low order.
fixed_scenarios.MAE_price: Same per-trade price MAE no matter what fraction; do NOT rescale price MAE as equity DD.
fixed_scenarios.time_window: train 25 and evaluation 22 each separately starting 500; combined all 47 starting 500
